title: Code and results for "Cross-Site Transfer of Conformal Abstention Guarantees in Interpretable Chest X-ray Concept Models"
description:
Python code and result files for the article "Cross-Site Transfer of Conformal Abstention Guarantees in Interpretable Chest X-ray Concept Models". The code builds a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder with nine linear, Platt-calibrated concept heads trained on NIH ChestX-ray14, and evaluates two conformal abstention rules, a split-conformal false-deferral threshold and a conformal risk control selective threshold, on-site and after transfer between NIH ChestX-ray14 and VinDr-CXR in both directions, on the primary split and on five re-splits.

The archive includes the result files and console logs of the reported run, from which every number in the article is taken, and a step-by-step reproduction guide.

The data are not redistributed. NIH ChestX-ray14 is available from the NIH Clinical Center, and VinDr-CXR from PhysioNet under credentialed access; the study used the 512-pixel copy redistributed on Kaggle. The archive contains no images.
